cells, row-major headings N, NW, SW, S, SE, NE. Subject in every cell: one compact WWI railway locomotive with a smokestack, a cab and visible wheels; no long train, no tracks. In each cell the
front, where the smokebox and smokestack end points, points towards that cell's heading. Saturated, naturally shaded magenta
only on the boiler and cab paint; everything else in natural materials. Whole subject centred on (256,261) within
the central 65 percent of every cell, all extremities inside, alpha zero outside the objects.

variants.delta: Top-left cell: the front (where the smokebox and smokestack end points) points up, away from the viewer; the rear and top are visible.
Top-right cell: the front (where the smokebox and smokestack end points) points to the upper left; the rear quarter and the flank facing lower left are visible.
Middle-left cell: the front (where the smokebox and smokestack end points) points to the lower left; the front quarter and the flank facing lower right are visible.
Middle-right cell: the front (where the smokebox and smokestack end points) points down, towards the viewer; the front is visible.
Bottom-left cell: the front (where the smokebox and smokestack end points) points to the lower right; the front quarter and the flank facing lower left are visible.
Bottom-right cell: the front (where the smokebox and smokestack end points) points to the upper right; the rear quarter and the flank facing lower right are visible.

assets.post:
`art-review -unit art/pipeline/unit-transport-train-v1.json` slices the atlas into the six facings with a fixed
anchor and framing inset, splits the magenta into a tint mask and recolours it to the owner palettes
`cp`, `ec` and `neutral` from the manifest, and derives the `spent` state (greyscale) from each tinted
sprite. Exports 2x (192x192) and 4x (384x384) of the 96x96 logical sprite, anchor (48,49);
`unit/transport-train/<palette>/<facing>-<state>`. Promote into `assets/units/transport-train/` and re-index.
avoid: rotated or mirrored copies of one view
magenta on skin, leather, metal, wood or horses
